Dear Miss Yonge
Yesterday [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379) paid [£200](../others.html#160) into [Hoare’s](../others.html#169) in your a/c. [I](../persons.html#939) hope my not telling you before will have caused you no [illegible]
I am very sorry you do not like the [illustrations](../others.html#167).[^1] It is now impossible to get fresh ones done, and pardon me saying I really like them. I hope you will get reconciled to them by and by
[Rest of letter indecipherable as is the one, dated 22 January 1868, that follows]

[^1]: These were presumably [Edward Armitage](../persons.html#60)\'s illustrations for [The Pupils of St.

John the Divine](../books.html#72) in Macmillan\'s [Sunday Library](../others.html#145) series.
